physicalNotes: Radius 0.27959723 Jupiter radii from Lillo-Box et al. 2020 (2020A&A...640A..48L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...640A..48L/abstract): 19,989 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.02548545 Jupiter masses (Lillo-Box et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...640A..48L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...640A..48L/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
